comment: Day 3 frozen evidence-span cases (docs/plans/2026-09-15-core-pro-development.md, Day 3). Each case names the exact line range that answers its query, established by reading the code, not by running the retriever. `group` is the corpus root the case is scored against; arms never see the other root. `split` is dev (used to pick the candidate) or heldout (scored once, after the candidate is frozen). A case may carry more than one class.
classes_comment: symbol = the query is the identifier; paraphrase = developer words vs compiler words; italian = the query is Italian and so is the evidence; negation = the query asks what must not / does not happen; dup-header = the evidence shares a boilerplate header with many sibling files; changed-file = the evidence sits in a file edited in the working tree this cycle; cross-border = the required span straddles a 40-line chunk boundary, so only a pack holding both neighbours covers it.
